structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions
State Council of Higher Education for Virginia

law.catch_line: Reports of expenditures of state funds
law.text: The governing board of each public institution of higher education shall provide the Council annual data indicating the apportionment and amounts of expenditures that the relevant institution expends by category, including academic costs, administration, research, and public service, as defined by the Council. The Council shall compile and submit a report of such data annually to the Governor and the General Assembly.
